newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom invests 100 mln DM in cable.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom invests 100 mln DM in cable.

text.p: German telecommunications giant Deutsche Telekom AG said on Thursday it would invest around 100 million marks ($63 million) in a project to build the world's longest and largest-capacity submarine cable network.
Telekom said it is the largest investor with a stake of five percent in the project. The network will be built by 90 telecommunications groups from four continents and cost $1.3 billion.
The fibre optic submarine cable is to meet burgeoning communications traffic in the fast-growing region and stretch from the South Pacific to the North Atlantic across Asia and the Middle East.
The 38,000 km (23,600 mile) network will be open to commercial traffic by the end of 1998.
The agreement to build the network was signed and announced on Wednesday in Singapore. ($ = 1.587 German Marks)
